notes.zh-CN: 新增 Claude 用量统计与套餐额度、消息英文转中文翻译、Kimi 套餐额度展示；系统通知点击回会话、终端登录/安装动作与按 Agent 账号管理等能力增强。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；Android APK 为调试签名；iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Adds Claude usage and plan limits, English-to-Chinese message translation, and Kimi plan quota display; improves system notifications that open the conversation, terminal login/install actions, and per-agent account management. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
